title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in Array

monster.name: XOR Titan
monster.title: Maximizer of Opposite Bit Alignments
monster.defeatQuote: Maximum pairwise XOR value constructed bit by bit!

description: Given an integer array `nums`, return the maximum result of `nums[i] XOR nums[j]`, where `0 <= i <= j < n`.
hints: Bitwise greedy search from bit 31 down to 0 using prefix sets. Target candidate ^ prefix in prefixes.
leetcodeTitle: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in Array
